front.title: Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6) Security Considerations

abstract.t: Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6) is the instantiation of Segment Routing on the IPv6 data plane, using IPv6 addresses to identify segments. This document discusses security considerations in SRv6 networks, including the potential threats and the possible mitigation methods. The document does not define any new security protocols or extensions to existing protocols.
